stylized rendering of hair or headdress in layered curved bands

justification: The only real overlap is the presence of a human head with stylized hair rendered as layered curved locks, which is a generic feature; A is a narrative processional frieze of costumed figures leading a two-humped camel between rosette borders, while B is an isolated sculpted head in the round with bared teeth and no scene, companions, animals or border ornament. The relationships, arrangement and overall composition share essentially nothing.
